exercises.title: 7. Pratique: Participle clauses — having met, being introduced

items.prompt: ___ been introduced by a mutual friend, we met naturally.
items.hintAfterError: Antes de 'been' + particípio, a oração participial usa a forma perfeita.

items.prompt: ___ known for her integrity, she was always invited.
Having ___ in the City for twenty years, he knew everyone.
Having been ___ by the chairman, she rose quickly.
___ in London, the team accessed European markets directly.
items.hintAfterError: Particípio de 'base', que pode vir precedido da forma -ing de 'be'.
